The editing beta. This is the release after v1.0.3, in one step, so the work in between does not get its own version. v1.0.0, v1.0.1, and v1.0.2 stay as they are, and v1.0.1 remains the latest stable build.

## Editing

- **Cursor after an insert.** Heading, italic, and note buttons leave the caret after the marker, including the trailing space (`## `).
- **Find and replace.** Ctrl or Cmd+F. Next, previous, match case, whole word, replace, and replace all. Replace all is one undo step.
- **Proper names.** Right-click **Add as name**. The capitalized spelling (for example `Elara`) is saved on that book, separate from the personal dictionary. Lowercase uses are flagged, and the saved spelling is the suggestion.
- **Contractions and capitals.** `I'm` and `don't` are recognized, and curly and straight apostrophes count as the same character. `I`, saved names, and the first word of a sentence are checked.
- **Fiction grammar.** Eight optional checks, each one switchable, shown as a soft dotted underline. The sentence is never rewritten for you: repeated words, `-ly` adverbs on dialogue tags, passive voice, filter words, a word echoed nearby, very long sentences, dialogue punctuation, and dialogue tags other than “said”.

Download the installer for your platform below.

> [!WARNING]
> The macOS build is the one to start with. The Windows and Linux builds come from the same pipeline and have had less hands-on use. Reports are welcome in the issues.

**Try it without installing:** https://crc64error.github.io/simple-author/

**macOS:** the app is not notarized. The first time, right-click the app and choose *Open*.
**Windows:** SmartScreen may warn about an unknown publisher. Choose *More info → Run anyway*.
